title: 2021-04-15 GitHub Inter IKEA organization and integrations to 3rd party applications
content:
Date:

Attendees:

tanguy.gouverneur@inter.ikea.com, Solution Owner / organization admin

, IPEX DevOps team

, IPEX DevOps team

Agenda

  • Align around current activities in the GitHub space

  • How organize support in the best way?

  • Current integration patterns is ok?

  • Is there a need for a sandbox GitHub organization?

Align around current activities in the GitHub space

There is a new GitHub organization planned. The reason for a new organization is that current organization is not set up in a secure manner. To change configuration of current organization implies breaking changes so the changes will be applied to new organization and existing projects migrated to the new setup. For example in the Azure AD app currently not considered as secure. No time plan set for this activity i.e. we will continue using current GitHub organization “inter-ikea”.

Share service account integration to Azure DevOps from third party applications.

How organize support in the best way?

Tanguy is the person behind the Service now form created.

It would be preferable that the teams have more of a self service of creating new repositories. IPEX DevOps team needs to do some configuration for IPEX sharing of repos to work.

Since it is only Tanguy that backs the Service now request flow, we should keep current flow where IPEX teams order repos through IPEX DevOps team for now.

Integration to GitHub background

Azure AD application

When setting up pipelines and working with automation there is a need to integrate to GitHub organization. Integration between GitHub and Azure DevOps is represented by an Azure AD application where security groups are added representing the different product teams.

PAT

There is at least one use case where integration to GitHub is done via PAT - AWS code build to GitHub. This has been solved in IPEX via Outlook group and usage of the group email for GitHub account and as well second factor during authentication.

Notes

For now both Azure AD application and Office group mail as mail in GitHub account is valid integrations for “inter-ikea” organization. @Tanguy will notify if there is any change. The pattern using Office group ensures that only users that are members of Office group have access to second factor i.e. GitHub account. Possibility to share QR code for authentication app. was as well shared. This has drawback that you do not know who has app configured.

Is there a need for a sandbox GitHub organization?

There has been a request from teams to have a sandbox organization to verify an try out new GitHub functionality. The current way of working is that you have to create a separate GitHub organization to try out functionality that is not enabled. If there is need to use code the source code would then be moved outside of IKEA owned organization. It would as well be convenient to have a lab organization available. @Tanguy will raise question regarding creating a sandbox GitHub organization. A policy for what can be expected in terms of data being available needs to be decided if there is a lab organization will full functionality.
